reference: Ku et al., 2025; Code2Video Appendix A.1.4 (Table 8)
description: Evaluation benchmark for LLM agents explaining mathematical theorems via multimodal animations.

theorems.statement: The normalized sum of n independent, identically distributed random variables with finite variance converges in distribution to a standard normal distribution as n approaches infinity.

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Correctly states requirements: finite variance and i.i.d.
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Demonstrates arbitrary non-normal distribution transforming into Gaussian bell curve
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Stepwise progression from n=1, n=2, to large n
eval_criteria.element_layout: Histogram on right grid, equation on top, no lecture bullet occlusion
eval_criteria.visual_consistency: Consistent color for random variables vs limiting Gaussian

theorems.statement: Differentiation and integration are inverse operations: if f is continuous on [a, b] and F is an antiderivative of f, then \int_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a).
theorems.formula: \frac{d}{dx} \int_a^x f(t) dt = f(x) \quad \text{and} \quad \int_a^b f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a)

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Rigorous link between accumulating area function A(x) and height f(x)
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Slice of width dx having area f(x)*dx causing change dA in total area
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Starts with area definition, zooms into marginal strip, shows dA/dx = f(x)
eval_criteria.element_layout: Area under curve aligned with derivative tangent on coordinate system
eval_criteria.visual_consistency: Area color corresponds to integral notation in formula

theorems.statement: In any right-angled triangle, the area of the square whose side is the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the areas of the squares on the other two sides.

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Flawless geometric deduction showing conservation of area
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Rigid animation of triangles without distortion
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Shows first configuration with inner c^2, shifts triangles to form a^2 and b^2
eval_criteria.element_layout: Square placement inside right 6x6 grid, equations in top/bottom anchors
eval_criteria.visual_consistency: Triangles maintain congruent colors throughout rearrangement

theorems.statement: Every real symmetric matrix A can be diagonalized by an orthogonal matrix Q consisting of its orthonormal eigenvectors, with real eigenvalues.
theorems.formula: A = Q \Lambda Q^T \quad \text{where} \quad Q^T Q = I

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Explicit mention of orthogonality of eigenspaces and reality of eigenvalues
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Transforming unit circle into ellipse whose principal axes are orthogonal eigenvectors
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Spatial transformation -> perpendicular axes preserved -> matrix factorization
eval_criteria.element_layout: Vector grid positioned in B2-E5, eigenvalues listed in F anchors
eval_criteria.visual_consistency: Eigenvector colors match their respective eigenvalues

theorems.statement: Let (X, d) be a non-empty complete metric space with a contraction mapping T: X -> X. Then T admits a unique fixed point x* in X.
theorems.formula: d(T(x), T(y)) \le q \cdot d(x, y) \quad (0 \le q < 1) \implies T(x^*) = x^*

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Clear definition of metric completeness and Lipschitz contraction constant q < 1
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Geometric shrinking of points x_0 -> x_1 -> x_2 converging to stationary point
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Contraction mapping definition -> iterative sequence -> Cauchy convergence -> uniqueness
eval_criteria.element_layout: Contraction mapping visually mapped inside B1-E5 grid

theorems.statement: For all vectors u and v in an inner product space, the absolute value of their inner product is less than or equal to the product of their norms.

eval_criteria.accuracy_depth: Proves equality holds if and only if u and v are linearly dependent
eval_criteria.visual_relevance: Geometric dot product as projection length ||u|| cos(theta) <= ||u||
eval_criteria.logical_flow: Vector projection -> orthogonal remainder -> norm inequality
eval_criteria.element_layout: Vectors plotted cleanly in C2-E4 with angle theta labeled
eval_criteria.visual_consistency: Consistent vector arrow notation and coordinate axes
